items.title: Eastern Falls to Central Michigan in Motor City MACtion
items.summary: The Eastern Michigan University football team fell to visiting rival Central Michigan University, 35-7, in the Motor City MACtion game at Ford Field in Detroit on Nov. 5, as both teams opened their midweek competition schedule with the 104th meeting in the series. The Eagles fell to 4-6 overall, and 3-3 in Mid-American Conference play while the Chippewas improved to 4-5 overall and 2-3 in league play.

items.title: Get Ready for the Fan Cam at the Motor City MACtion Game!
Know Before You Go: Motor City MACtion Edition as Eastern Michigan Takes Over Ford Field
items.summary: It might be the home of the Detroit Lions, but for one night, it's OUR home! Eastern Michigan University Football is trading the gray turf of Rynearson Stadium for the bright lights of Ford Field Wednesday, Nov. 4, when the Eagles host rival Central Michigan University at 7:30 p.m. in downtown Detroit.

items.title: EMU is Motor City MACtion Ready for Nov. 4
items.summary: After an 11-day break from competition, the Eastern Michigan University football team returns to the field for a midweek, Mid-American Conference (commonly dubbed "#MACtion") match up against Central Michigan University Wednesday, Nov. 4. Kickoff is set for 7:30 p.m. inside Ford Field, home of the Detroit Lions and the 2027 NCAA Men's Basketball Final Four.
